requirements.description: _glob_resources(resource_path, subdir, ext) yields POSIX relative names; ext must start with '.' and contain no '*'.
Works for pathlib.Path (glob '*ext', relative_to) and zipfile.Path-like objects (assert directory exists, iterdir, endswith ext, 'subdir/name').
requirements.alternatives: is_dir() or exists() assertion; f-string or posixpath.join

requirements.description: Names not ending in ext (README, unrelatedhtml) are excluded.
preload_resources uses _glob_resources for ('html','.html') and ('javascript','.js') and caches by the same POSIX key.
